notes.title: Lightless Update
notes.notes:
Version 2.0.0:

* Camera pictures will be saved in the gallery
* Camera can capture more paranormal events
* New Steam achievements added
* Hotspots are labeled for easier interactions
* Puzzles rebalanced
* More  screen resolutions are now supported
* Religion related contents revised
* General bugfixes and gameplay improvements performed

notes.title: Lightless Update
notes.notes:
In this update:
* Mouse cursor graphics improved so that it stands out from the background for easier hot spot detection.
* Functionality improved and some issues related to writing system resolved.
* Difficulty level of certain puzzles are revised and balanced.

notes.title: Lightless Update
notes.notes:
In this version, automatic and manual diagnostics modules have been added for continues monitoring and faster problem solving.
I have also done some improvements and balancing by making some of the puzzles more convenient.
Thanks for playing and hope you enjoy the new version : )

notes.title: Lightless Update
notes.notes:
I have improved the early puzzles to avoid confusion and also made some objects easier to interact with. 
I will keep improving the game and I hope I can make the experience more pleasant : )
